distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) accepts Coccotrypes carpophagus as occurring in Taiwan.

host_note: The source states that the species is polyphagous in seeds and fruits, especially palms. This broad ecological statement is retained without inferring particular host taxa.
